speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The loaf is a penny. It is still a thumb short of the notch. I measured it yesterday. I am not measuring it again for your Sunday face.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not asking you to measure it. The clove is going in. The jaw is the jaw.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Left side. Hold still, sir. I am not crushing it twice, and I am not going out for another.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: This one will do. Church is at nine. I can hear a sermon on one side.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You can hear it. Whether you bring any of it home is your own affair. Eat the soft of the loaf and leave the crust.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three bites. The same as yesterday. I am not making a cure out of a quieter board.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Your cloak is by the stair. Gib is on the book again. I did not move him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave him. The book is lent, and the cat is the only clerk it has.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Church, then. If the parish asks after your face, you may tell them it is a tooth. You may not tell them it is a story.
